605:t_044:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And they've done so ever since humanity set foot on the Moon...」

605:t_044:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Why have they been doing that?」

605:t_044:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「We'll have to ask them directly for that answer.」

605:t_044:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「None of you have given in to despair, have you?」

605:t_044:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「Honestly, I'm scared... Their scale, their power, and their aims far exceed anything we imagined.」

605:t_044:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Whatever happened in the past, we'll teach them just how wrong they are if they think they can keep us as livestock forever.」

605:t_044:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Humanity's evolution isn't ours to decide... But if anyone stands in its way, let's fight them with everything we have.」

605:t_044:9.en:
$$シャア$$
「Anyone who bars the future... is our enemy.」

605:t_044:10.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Now that $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has been wiped out, our destination is $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

605:t_044:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This is different from last time. This time, we will win.」

605:t_044:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You all... haven't changed... No... you've grown stronger than before.」

605:t_044:13.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We've been through a lot too.」

605:t_044:14.en:
$$カレン$$
「Especially $n has been through a lot.」

605:t_044:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Tell me what happened while I was gone, $n.」

605:t_044:18.en:
$n
(The immortal $$アサキム$$, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ who returns even after being erased...)

605:t_044:19.en:
$n
(Is that power... related to how I rewound time...?)

605:t_045:0.en:
$$ブルー$$
「So this is as far as I go...!」

605:t_045:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Wait, $$ブルー$$! How much do you know about $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?!」

605:t_045:2.en:
$$ブルー$$
「The Captain is our guide... We simply eliminate anyone who obstructs his purpose.」

605:t_046:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What the hell was that...? Does he believe in $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ from the bottom of his heart...?」

605:t_047:1.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Whatever you say, it's no use, $n. As long as you are the Captain's enemy, you are mine too.」

605:t_048:2.en:
$n
「...I'm all right, Miss $$スズネ$$... I... can fight.」

605:t_048:3.en:
$n
($$マキ#pilot$$... Even if it's you I'm facing...)

605:t_049:0.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Not bad, $n. It looks like you've put what happened with your mother behind you.」

605:t_049:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Sorry. It seems our minds linked for an instant when you took my $$スフィア$$.」

605:t_049:3.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「That's how I learned the root of the despair inside you.」

605:t_049:4.en:
$n
「...Is that all you have to say?」

605:t_049:5.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Easy. I don't intend to fight you right now.」

605:t_049:6.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
(Judging by that reaction, he hasn't completely overcome it yet...)

605:t_049:7.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
(Now, will that turn out for good or ill...?)

605:t_100:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Let's have our final showdown, $n.」

605:t_100:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What's wrong? Aren't you going to say, 'I'll get Miss $$スズネ$$ back!' like you always do?」

605:t_100:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So you've given up. Even the man who goes beyond hope and despair seems to have realized he's lost.」

605:t_100:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Then I'll take $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$! That settles everything!」

605:t_100:6.en:
$n
「...Come on, $$アムブリエル$$...! Let me tell you, I haven't given up one bit!」

605:t_100:7.en:
$n
「First, I'll stop you! Everything else comes after that!」

605:t_101:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n... You really are wonderful.」

605:t_101:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Meeting you has been one of my greatest joys.」

605:t_101:3.en:
$n
「Don't screw with me! I'm not your property!」

605:t_101:4.en:
$n
「I won't hesitate anymore! You shot Miss $$スズネ$$, and you're my enemy!!」

605:t_102:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I understand, $$セツコ$$... You're sad that you've ended up fighting me.」

605:t_102:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But I'll overcome my sorrow...! And the doubt and fear in my heart too!」

605:t_102:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Sorrow makes you strong... It seems $$アサキム$$'s methods were right after all.」

605:t_102:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then I will take his place and give you even greater sorrow.」

605:t_103:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「To think it would end up like this...!」

605:t_103:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「This is different from our last battle... You endure the doubts and guilt within you and face me.」

605:t_103:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Maybe so... But there's an even stronger feeling inside me... Anger at you!」

605:t_103:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you've got an excuse, hurry up and give it! Otherwise, I really will beat the hell out of you!」

605:t_103:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's good. I want one hundred percent of your power.」

605:t_104:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This sure hasn't turned out the way I'd hoped.」

605:t_104:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You say that, but I believe some part of you foresaw this day ever since we were working together on the $$翠の地球$$.」

605:t_104:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Your strong will sustains your intuition. This was decided from the moment we met.」

605:t_104:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Choose your words carefully. You're the one who decided it, aren't you?」

605:t_104:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You really are frightening. Let me test how far your power can grow.」

605:t_105:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So it has come to this... I'm disappointed, $$アサキム$$.」

605:t_105:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But beyond that fact, I cannot tolerate your very existence.」

605:t_105:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's fine. Live as freely as you wish.」

605:t_105:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Live... What a hollow word.」

605:t_106:0.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I've come back to pay you back, you bastard!」

605:t_106:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Directing your anger at me is misguided.」

605:t_106:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「You're still making excuses, even now?!」

605:t_106:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Very well, $$ガドライト#pilot$$. If it will satisfy you, I will receive those feelings.」

605:t_106:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That too is probably my duty.」

605:t_106:5.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「That's the end of your smug attitude! Prepare yourself, damn you!」
